title: Choose the Overview structure
question: Which composition should become ASC Studio’s Overview? Each option keeps the current interface language and uses only data the product can read today.

options.label: Operations Matrix
options.thesis: See Ship, Test, Grow, and Activity as one live operating matrix for the selected app.
options.viewport: A concise header gives way to four asymmetric workflow lanes; each lane pairs one truthful state summary with the next available action, and recent activity anchors the lower edge.
options.risk: The matrix must preserve clear priority so four equally useful lanes do not become four equally loud panels.

options.label: Release Train
options.lineage: One product lifecycle from build to growth
options.thesis: Make the current release the spine, with TestFlight, App Review, store readiness, and Apple Ads arranged around its progress.
options.viewport: A wide lifecycle rail dominates the first view, a narrow attention column explains blockers and next actions, and supporting performance and activity sit below.
options.risk: It is strongest during an active release and must still feel useful between release cycles.

options.label: Command Center
options.thesis: Lead with what needs attention now, then show the live evidence that explains each recommendation.
options.viewport: A large ordered attention queue owns the left side; service health, current release, TestFlight, and Ads evidence stack on the right; activity runs across the foot.
options.risk: A recommendation-first page needs careful empty states so a healthy app never looks unfinished.
